source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The repack script captures the linter status instead of letting set -e stop at lint failure, then creates and moves the tar and Flatpak bundle before returning that status. Packaging errors can still stop earlier. The image copies the application-specific exception map beside the script; the accepted image later supplies the linter and clears its inherited entry point. This is static source evidence, not a successful release or lint run.
title: Flatpak repacking returns lint failure after packaging the artifacts
